slices.name: native-objective

sourceEvidence.includes: Exercised extension, contracts and workflow source copies per stage

slices.result: Compiled interactive OMP hosted a mandate-derived objective workflow: two dependent native task items, one independent command item and one named blocker. Successor dispatched without operator prompt; one send and one accepted binding-exact receipt per binding; owned hosts exit0. S2 root turn_end between request and result; S3-rotation committed session_compact while the handoff was pending; S4-recovery /restart reinitialized the extension factory, recovered the pending handoff and attached to the existing workflow without a second admission.
historicalFailures: S3: session too small to compact; no session_compact (summarize exit1).
S4: restart sent as ordinary text; no new extension instance (summarize exit1).
limitations: Restart recovery proven pending-before-send only; not crash recovery after dispatch or child loss.
Durable sent marker and sendMessage are not atomic; no crash-safe exactly-once claim.
Adversarial receipt injection not exercised.
/reload-plugins does not reinitialize extension factories; same-version /restart is not self-update proof.
Numeric bindings are experiment counters, not Git revision authority or fenced leases.
Summaries reconcile recorded events, not independently fetched Temporal history.
Synchronous task only; async completion unproven.
